raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. ( animal ) anjing; 2. male dog, anjing jantan; 3. also dog-fox, rubah jantan; 4. also dog-wolf, serigala jantan; 5. ( colloq ) fellow, orang: he’s a lucky ~, dia orang yg bertuah; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vt mengekori: a stranger ~ged us, seorang yg tdk dikenali mengekori kami; 2. ( fig. ) memburu: he seems ~ged by misfortune, nampaknya dia diburu oleh nasib malang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ eat ~, saling jatuh-menjatuhkan; a ~’s life, sengsara; die like a ~, die a ~’s death, mati dlm keadaan yg hina; a dirty ~, ( colloq ) dishonourable or evil person, anjing: he ran away with the old man’s money, the dirty ~, dia melarikan duit orang tua itu, anjing betul; lead a ~’s life, hidup sengsara; not have a ~’s chance, ( colloq ) tak ada can langsung; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
